title: Section 1 test
intro: Lessons 1 to 7. Three short parts: match words, fill a gap, then finish a conversation. Pass with 70% or higher.

parts.title: Part 3 · Conversation
parts.intro: Pick the line that fits the scene.

questions.question: zdravo
questions.explanation: Zdravo is the everyday informal hello.

questions.question: doviđenja
questions.explanation: Doviđenja is how you say goodbye.

questions.question: moj otac
questions.explanation: Moj goes with a masculine noun. Otac means father.

questions.question: danas
questions.explanation: Danas means today. Sutra means tomorrow.

questions.question: _____ sam Ana.
questions.explanation: Ja sam means I am. That is the first-person form of biti.

questions.question: Ja sam _____ Sarajeva.
questions.explanation: Ja sam iz plus a place name tells where you come from.

questions.question: _____ je Mostar?
questions.explanation: Gdje je asks where something is.

questions.question: Koliko je _____?
questions.explanation: Koliko je sati? asks what time it is.

questions.question: Amira: Zdravo, Ana! Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: A greeting gets a greeting back. Zdravo, Amira! is the natural reply.

questions.question: Emir: Kako se zoveš? Ana: _____.
questions.explanation: Kako se zoveš? asks your name. Zovem se Ana answers it.

questions.question: Ana (at the café): _____. Amira: Izvoli.
questions.explanation: Jednu kahvu, molim is a polite coffee order. Izvoli is Amira handing it over.

questions.question: Ana: Ko je to? Emir: _____.
options: To je Mrvica. Ona je mačka.
questions.explanation: Ko je to? asks who that is. Mrvica is the café cat.
